name: guardrails
description: Safety and review of Claude's output. Six mods, each toggled in the plugin config. blast-radius: holds destructive shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE...) behind a card showing the files at risk; pick Proceed or Cancel. secret-sentry: denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit that would put API keys, tokens or private keys in a file (.env and *.example exempt). reflect: spots lasting corrections in your prompts (or 'remember: ...') and offers to save them to ./CLAUDE.md or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; /reflect-queue, /reflect-pause. assumption-tracker: after each turn lists what Claude assumed; mark Right or Wrong and send a fix for the wrong ones; /assumptions. self-critique: /critique [auto|opus|sonnet|haiku] reviews Claude's last answer with a verdict, flaws and a Make this fix button. prompt-coach: holds the first prompt of a session (once per session, tracked per session id so a reload cannot re-fire it) and interviews you one question at a time (with options) in a side pane, then writes an improved prompt (role, goal, context, requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria) with your original quoted; Use, Copy, Request changes or Dismiss (sends the original); a first prompt that is already clear shows 'Looks good' and is sent as is; a first prompt with attachments is sent as typed and the improved text is only offered to copy; /sharpen <prompt> runs it on demand.
